belief: Pocahontas became a celebrity during her 1616-1617 visit to England, causing a sensation among the English upper crust, being elegantly fêted, and attending a masque at Whitehall Palace

author: worker_1
belief: Pocahontas was noted in the context and culture she lived in - she met King James I and Queen Anne, was entertained by the Bishop of London, had an engraving made of her by Simon van de Passe, and was the subject of contemporary writings by John Smith and others

author: worker_1
belief: The claim that Pocahontas became a kind of celebrity in her lifetime and was noted in her context and culture is SUPPORTED by publicly available evidence
